_source: assets/addison-bulletin-board.md — the full design has two pools, per-posting posted_day/pulled_day, and multi-day arcs. This is the subset that fits on a post-it: short enough to read at a glance beside the notice, which is the only thing the player came to the board for.
_ambient: Rotated per shift, seeded off the level so a board is the same board every time you play it. NEVER references the story. The Mercer thread is legible only because everything around it is noise about brisket and Pablo.
ambient: It's not the dog's fault.
It's a little bit the dog's fault.
The bags are FREE. They are RIGHT THERE.
FOR SALE: Treadmill. Barely used. Obviously.
FREE: Piano. You move it. It does not work.
PABLO IS AN OUTDOOR CAT. HE IS FINE.
Whoever keeps feeding Pablo: please stop.
Pablo has gained four pounds.
My gnome is gone. This is not a joke to me.
$90 for grass. Ninety. American. Dollars.
The board meets at 2pm on a Tuesday. Think about that.
POOL CLOSED. We know.
Book club is now a wine club. Same night. No books.
FOUND: One shoe. Child's. Left foot.
I make tamales. Text me. Don't tell the HOA.
LOCK YOUR CARS. This is the fourth notice.
There is nowhere out of view. I have looked.
Does anyone have a truck? I'll buy a lot of tacos.
Speed bump denied. Reason: aesthetics.
LAWN CARE — $35 weekly. I am fourteen.
Piano lessons. My house. Please, my house.
Recycling suspended since March. Temporarily.
Can someone teach me to use a weed trimmer.
Whoever has my grill grate: I know.
Whoever parks in front of my house: there are two other spots.
It's a public street.
Brisket confirmed for the block party. He said yes.
I have read the covenants. All sixty-one pages.
FREE: 400 bricks. I don't want to talk about it.
Holiday decorations off by January 15. Not negotiable.
Postings require prior approval.
The swing is still under review. Eight months.
_story: Keyed by shift, and fixed. One per board, so the thread is always there and never twice. Pool A carries the joke; these are the ones the player is supposed to catch.
